start: Owner online, More → Help and feedback

steps.action: Type a question in 'Your message' and tap 'Send'
user_sees: Title 'Help and feedback'
'Ask a question and get an answer at once. Or tell us what works, what is hard, or what you want next. Hindi or English. On a phone you can tap the microphone on your keyboard to speak.'
Button reads 'Sending…'
An answer with 'Answer written by AI from our help pages.' and 'Did this solve it?' with Yes / No
must_not: The message sent twice
The box emptied when the send failed
A member’s name or number added to the message by the app

user_sees: 'Got it. We reply as soon as we can.'
The question in the list of your questions with its answer
must_not: The rating sent for another question
No way to see a later reply from the team

start: Owner online, Help and feedback, the 'MettleUp access' card at the bottom

steps.action: Tap 'Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)'; in 'Let MettleUp support look?' tap 'Yes, for 1 hour'
user_sees: Words that support can read members, plans, receipts, check-ins, shop orders and the staff list for the next hour and cannot change anything
A 'Close it now' button while it is open
The window in the access list
must_not: A window longer than one hour
Support able to change records
The window opened without the question
Two windows from a double tap

user_sees: The window shown as ended in the list
must_not: Support still able to look after it is closed

steps.action: Leave the box empty; then type 2,000 letters and keep typing; then send with no internet
user_sees: 'Send' is off while the box is empty
Typing stops at 2,000 letters
'Couldn't send. Check your internet and try again. Your message is still here.'
must_not: The message lost
A thank-you shown for a message that did not go

steps.action: Ask a question when the AI credits are used up
user_sees: An answer from the help pages and a button 'Open AI Assistant'
must_not: Credits taken for an answer that did not use the AI
No answer at all

start: Owner asked a question yesterday; the team replied since; support never looked at the gym

user_sees: Yesterday’s question with the team’s reply, marked as new once
'MettleUp has never opened your records.' in the access card
must_not: The reply marked new again after it was seen
The history empty on the same browser

steps.action: Let support look, wait until the hour ends, open the page again
user_sees: The window listed as ended, with each look support made
must_not: The window still open after one hour
A look that is not listed

start: Owner reads the MettleUp access card before letting support look

steps.action: Read the card and the list
user_sees: 'MettleUp sees only your gym’s totals (how many members, check-ins and money in all), never a member’s name or number. MettleUp support can look at your records only when you let them, for one hour at most, and only to read…'
Every look with its time
must_not: A look outside a window not shown
The card shown to staff
The card shown for a gym that is not online as if it worked

start: Staff online, More → Help and feedback

steps.action: Type a message in 'Your message' and tap 'Send'
user_sees: Button reads 'Sending…'
'Thanks! We read every message.' or an answer with 'Did this solve it?'
must_not: The message sent twice
A member’s details added by the app

start: Staff online on Help and feedback

user_sees: No 'MettleUp access' card
must_not: Staff able to open the gym’s records to support

steps.action: Ask a question when the gym’s AI credits are used up
user_sees: An answer from the help pages with no button to the AI Assistant
must_not: An 'Open AI Assistant' button that staff cannot use

start: Staff asked a question earlier on this browser

user_sees: The earlier question with its answer or reply
must_not: The reply marked new every time

start: Staff uses the desk browser where the owner also asked questions

user_sees: Unknown from the code read whether the questions list is kept per person or per browser
must_not: The owner’s questions to MettleUp and their answers shown to staff
Who looked at the gym’s records shown to staff
